descriptor: Independent homeware shop with secure checkout

voice.summary: Sounds like a shopkeeper who comes round the counter when the card machine fails: calm, clear and kind. It says first that nothing was charged, then helps, never blames.
dos: Say what has and hasn't happened in the first sentence
Offer one clear next step at a time
Keep the basket and the time left visible
donts: Do not blame the customer or the bank
Do not use alarm words like failed transaction
Do not hide the support option

taglines: Your basket is safe with us
A hiccup, not a dead end
Homewares you can take your time over
boilerplate: Oakhill Home is an independent British homeware shop selling considered furniture and kitchen pieces, with secure checkout and a team of real people on hand when something goes wrong.

microcopy.success: Payment received. Your order is on its way.
microcopy.error: Your payment didn't go through. You haven't been charged.
microcopy.empty: Your basket is empty. Browse the shop to begin.

logo.note: A simple house shape suits a homeware shop and signals a safe, familiar place.
